stories.title: The method for estimating a dinosaurs' age at death may be off, research suggests
stories.summary: A growing body of research on dinosaurs' closest living relatives suggests the method that's been used to estimate how old a dinosaur was when it died may be leading paleontologists astray.

stories.title: Bad Bunny made history taking home the Grammy for album of the year
stories.summary: Bad Bunny made history Sunday night at the Grammys, taking home the most coveted prize: album of the year.

stories.title: Opening of Rafah crossing is just the start of a massive undertaking to rebuild Gaza
stories.summary: Gaza's key border crossing with Egypt opened briefly for the first time in a year. Only a handful Palestinians were able to leave, but it's an important step in an undertaking to rebuild Gaza.

stories.title: Amid power outages, an unusual number of locals visit Nashville's honky tonk district
stories.summary: While winter storms caused major power outages in Nashville, its downtown music scene saw a lot more locals who took up hotel rooms usually occupied by tourists.

stories.title: An uneasy détente: Trump and Colombia's Petro to meet at White House
stories.summary: Of all the relationships Trump has had with world leaders, the one with Colombia's President has perhaps been one of  the most volatile - but for the first time on Tuesday, President Petro will hold a face to face meeting with President Trump at the White House.

stories.title: In her last Olympic season, US cross-country ski phenom Jessie Diggins looks stronger than ever
stories.summary: Olympic gold medalist and winningest US cross country skier ever Jessie Diggins is hanging up her ski boots at the end of this season. Her openness about struggling with eating disorders has won her fans off of snow, too.
